strong_shape_200m_definition.raw_ranking: walk-forward subtype probability, fallback observed inflow score

selective_70_definition.training_population: prior live-detectable strong-shape signals with completed next-open five-day outcomes
selective_70_definition.shape_model: separate empirical Bayes model for each strong shape

features.theme_flow_proxy: TSE-33/TSE-17 sector trend score >= 60% and breadth >= 50%
features.volume_continuation: 5d/20d volume and turnover ratios are both >= 1

selective_70_definition.note: The repository has no historical Kabutan-theme membership series, so leakage-safe sector flow is used as the theme-flow proxy.

ml_selective_60_study.leakage_control: shape-specific models are refit in chronological blocks using only outcomes completed before each block; configuration is tuned on the first half and frozen for the final half
ml_selective_60_study.features: price, volume, turnover, volatility, RSI, ATR, candle close location, market breadth, TSE-17/TSE-33 flow proxies, observed inflow, retail flow, Sakata score, and next-open gap known at order time
ml_selective_60_study.selection_rule: configuration chosen only from three chronological development folds; validation half was untouched

sharp_selloff_candidate.caveat: shape restriction was identified during validation analysis; freeze it before collecting new dates for a fully untouched confirmation

ten_day_signal_study.target: 翌営業日始値から10営業日以内に日中高値+5%
ten_day_signal_study.entry: 翌営業日始値（ギャップ上限は注文時に確認）
ten_day_signal_study.deployment_rule: 未使用後半30件以上・10営業日+5%達成率60%以上・平均損益プラス

limit_order_study.intraday_ambiguity_rule: when an intraday low first reaches the limit, day-one high is excluded from target evaluation; gap-at-open fills may use day-one high
limit_order_study.caveat: Frozen validation signals from the 150000000 yen minimum-turnover universe are reused. This is a post-selection execution study, so forward confirmation is required.

portfolio_study.same_day_sequence: scheduled exits, then entries; same-day entry/exit proceeds are not reused for another entry; if stop and target touch on the same daily bar, stop is assumed first
portfolio_study.caveat: Walk-forward model scores avoid future-outcome leakage, but the frozen signal parameters were selected using part of this same three-year history.

portfolio_hold_to_day10_study.exit_rule: hold every filled trade through tenth-trading-day close
portfolio_hold_to_day10_study.same_day_sequence: scheduled exits, then entries; same-day entry/exit proceeds are not reused for another entry; if stop and target touch on the same daily bar, stop is assumed first
portfolio_hold_to_day10_study.caveat: Walk-forward model scores avoid future-outcome leakage, but the frozen signal parameters were selected using part of this same three-year history.

stop_loss_study.comparison: fixed stop from -1% through -20%, plus no stop
stop_loss_study.same_bar_assumption: stop executes before +5% target on ambiguous daily bars
stop_loss_study.note: An eventual-target false stop is a trade stopped before it later reaches +5% within the original ten-trading-day window.

portfolio_two_million_stop_study.same_day_sequence: scheduled exits, then entries; same-day entry/exit proceeds are not reused for another entry; if stop and target touch on the same daily bar, stop is assumed first
portfolio_two_million_stop_study.caveat: Walk-forward model scores avoid future-outcome leakage, but the frozen signal parameters were selected using part of this same three-year history.

portfolio_two_million_topix_etf_study.same_day_sequence: scheduled exits, then entries; same-day entry/exit proceeds are not reused for another entry; if stop and target touch on the same daily bar, stop is assumed first
portfolio_two_million_topix_etf_study.topix_uptrend_rule: previous adjusted close > 200-day moving average and 25-day moving average > 75-day moving average; execute at next open
portfolio_two_million_topix_etf_study.asset_priority: sell TOPIX ETF before a fillable individual-stock entry; never hold both
portfolio_two_million_topix_etf_study.caveat: Walk-forward model scores avoid future-outcome leakage, but the frozen signal parameters were selected using part of this same three-year history.

demo_trade_signal_study.note: 平均3営業日に1回の検知を目標に選んだRSI14条件。RSI25〜35、前日比-3〜0%、5日騰落-15〜+2%、出来高比1.5倍以上、売買代金3億円以上、ATR2〜12%、25日線下の陽線を出来高比順に1日最大3銘柄。

turnover_sensitivity.note: 投げ売り反転・予測閾値・損失確率条件・1日最大1銘柄を固定し、最低売買代金だけを5000万円刻みで変更。各流動性母集団でウォークフォワードモデルを再学習し、同じ検証期間で比較

additional_validation.note: 投げ売り反転は前回の検証結果を確認後に固定したため、この再検証は頑健性確認。完全な未使用検証は今後のシグナルで行う

ten_day_signal_study.leakage_control: 各評価ブロックの10営業日前までに結果が確定したデータだけで再学習。条件選択は前半、成績評価は未使用の後半で実施
ten_day_signal_study.caveat: 投げ売り反転だけを採用対象に固定した10営業日の新規シグナル。過去3年の再検証は形状選択後の頑健性確認であり、完全な未使用検証は今後30件の新規シグナルで継続する。決算跨ぎと重要指標前の既存制限を適用する
